angles.headline: Street art as a streetwear-style brand
angles.pitch: How Avery built Alec Monopoly into a global brand with sold-out shows and major brand partnerships, using drop and collab tactics streetwear audiences know.
angles.builds_on: MSCHF and Tremaine Emory episodes (art/brand crossover).

angles.headline: Click & Mortar before it was a thing
angles.pitch: ArtLife.com (2015) as one of the first online-only blue-chip galleries, scaled to eight figures a year with social-first marketing and curated pop-ups, a playbook Hypebeast readers will recognise from streetwear.

angles.headline: Back on Hypebeast: from ArtLife Auctions to celebrity collectors
angles.pitch: Hypebeast covered Avery's ArtLife Auctions launch in 2020; he can update that story with how celebrities and athletes now buy art.
angles.builds_on: Hypebeast's 2020 coverage of Avery (relationship hook rather than an episode).

booking.route: No guest route documented, and the show appears dormant. Best documented route: Hypebeast editorial (the network that covered ArtLife Auctions in 2020) or Angelo Baque directly via Awake NY; neither has a verified booking contact.
